dqr.subject: Humidity Data Incorrect
dqr.description: Suspected lightning damage caused incorrect relative humidity and vapor pressure data during this time. Temperature data remained accurate. Sensor was replaced.

reference.warning: The reference is this station's own trailing window: this fault lasts 104 hours against a 168-hour window, so the reference is partly contaminated by the fault and the estimate here is weakened. A neighbour reference needs contemporaneous coverage across the co-located SGP stations; see scripts/fetch_sgp_block.ps1.

panel.note: only hardware fired; nothing corroborates it
